newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BIJENKORF WARNS OF SHARPLY LOWER YR NET.
newsitem.headline: BIJENKORF WARNS OF SHARPLY LOWER YR NET.

text.p: Dutch department stores group Koninklijke Bijenkorf Beheer NV (KBB) said on Friday that lower-than-expected results at its M&S Mode clothing unit in late 1996 would drag on group net from normal operations for the year to end-January.
"KBB announces that results at M&S Mode in the final months of calendar 1996 were below expectations. The positive trend in other (group) businesses continued.
"Given the scale of losses at M&S Mode, we expect net results from normal operations to be significantly lower than in the previous year.
"A current initial estimate for the net result for the year to January 31 would be between 55 and 60 million guilders," the group said in a statement.
Preliminary results will be announced on March 6.
KBB posted final 1995/96 net profit from ordinary operations of 98.6 million guilders, some 20 percent lower than year-earlier levels.
